# Section 5 loaded range

Section 5 loads 0x60843000..0x60846000; the 4 KiB before section 6 is not loaded.

**Category:** layout · **Address:** `0x60843000` to `0x60846000` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md)

A failed overlay build used 0x60847000 as its end and ran 3,036 bytes past the load. A direct-memory emulator fixture hid the error.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md)): Bounds from the native descriptor table and end selector. Source: [OM-5 Mark II startup readiness correction](../sources/om5.startup-fix.md).
